description: Agent spending vault plus payment-backed reputation on Solana devnet (two Anchor 0.31.1 programs). credit_vault create_vault, deposit, update_policy and spend, and reputation initialize_agent, register_service, record_payment, give_feedback and compute_score were verified.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of frankolien/agent_fuel. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/agent_fuel. The lab only changed both declare_ids to unique Sol.College devnet programs. The hosted IDLs are the upstream SDK IDLs with the lab addresses substituted; discriminators were confirmed by live transactions. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (credit_vault limits and whitelist; reputation receipts, feedback and score)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/agent-fuel/
QA: devnet proof of a policy-checked agent spend recorded as reputation
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Exercise request_spend, approve_spend and claim with allow_post_pay
